dedupe_keys.name: kenya cell tower locations american red cross hdx 2019

description: The American Red Cross shared a table of cell tower locations in Kenya on the Humanitarian Data Exchange, dated February 2019. The dataset page describes it as cell tower locations showing different signals, such as CDMA, LTE and GSM, and holds one CSV file of about 82 KB, stored on Google Drive. Coverage: Kenya, point locations of towers with their radio technology. Format and access: CSV linked from HDX, free under CC BY. Caveats: the source of the positions is not stated and may be crowdsourced cell databases; a single snapshot from 2019; the Red Cross organisation on HDX is marked inactive, so it will not be updated; the file sits on Google Drive, not HDX. Simulation uses: tower positions for hazard exposure of Kenyan mobile networks to floods and for coverage-gap estimates in humanitarian planning. Related records: data-opencellid gives crowdsourced cell positions for Kenya with more recent updates; data-ca-kenya-quarterly-sector-statistics gives national subscriptions from the regulator.
